touches.text: The walk: a first HYPOTHESIS (0.7). CC's draft, written so the experiments (4.3.1.10) have something to be wrong about; it is replaced by what they show. WHY: Akien sets what the trees are for and judges what they do; the mechanism is the teammate's draft, the way the geogebra model was for the 3d scanner, and it is learned here by running it, not by specifying it first.
Transient: things held for seconds to days (mail, logs, test runs, trouble tickets, inference tickets). The logging tree.
Hollow runs: proves a proof goes red when the build is removed.
orient: the measuring scans before a build (where is X called, what's in each component). WHY: a build starts from what is, measured, not recalled. USERS: CodeMother's orient machine.
scratch: a proof's throwaway temp dirs and worktrees, cleaned up by the door. WHY: a run must leave nothing behind (4.3.1.7). USERS: the tester.
